title: Luminous Tiles
description: Colorful crystal mosaic with selectable shapes, colors drawn from the source, continuous shape morphing and crystal deformation, turning cuts, refracted colors and light driven directly by music.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Blend the glass with the original image.

parameters.label: Shape Type
parameters.description: Morph the glass shape: 0 Crystal, 1 Hexagon, 2 Square, 3 Diamond, 4 Brick, 5 Lozenge, 6 Prism, 7 Shards.

parameters.label: Tile Count
parameters.description: Approximate pieces along the shorter image side.

parameters.label: Crystal Depth
parameters.description: Depth of the cut faces and their refracted color.

parameters.label: Facet Turn
parameters.description: Turn the crystal cuts and refract their colors with mid frequencies.

parameters.label: Edge Light
parameters.description: Fine highlights along glass edges, responding to high frequencies.

parameters.label: Color Split
parameters.description: Subtle separation of colors at refracting edges.

parameters.label: Crystal Pulse
parameters.description: Local cell expansion, cut movement and light responding to musical attacks.

provenance.prompt_summary: Colorful crystal mosaic with selectable shapes, colors drawn from the source, continuous shape morphing and crystal deformation, turning cuts, refracted colors and light driven directly by music.
